t: An open source platform for running Python inside web pages.
steps: Find PyScript on its official site and read the getting started page.
Create a basic HTML page on a teacher computer.
Add the PyScript stylesheet and script to the page.
Write a line of Python in a script tag with type py.
Open the page in a browser while online.
Try the config file and a separate Python source file.
Host the page on a school server for students.
